subject: [RFC PATCH 30/57] mm/collapse: name the max_ptes ceiling after collapse

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch renames a constant in the Linux kernel's memory management code to better reflect its purpose. The constant, previously named KHUGEPAGED_MAX_PTES_LIMIT, is used as a ceiling for the maximum number of page table entries (PTEs) that can be collapsed by the khugepaged process. It has been renamed to COLLAPSE_MAX_PTES_LIMIT to match other constants in the same header file and to improve clarity. The change affects several files in the kernel's memory management code, including collapse.c, collapse.h, and khugepaged.c.
